#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# -e: exit immediately if any command exits non-zero
# -u: treat any unset variable as an error
# -o pipefail: a pipeline fails if ANY stage fails,
#              not just the last one
caption: Northbridge Retail's deploy script failed silently without this line.

code:
LOCK_FILE="/tmp/northbridge-deploy.lock"

cleanup() {
  rm -f "$LOCK_FILE"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ -e "$LOCK_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: another deploy is running" >&2
  exit 1
fi

touch "$LOCK_FILE"
caption: The EXIT trap fires even if the script dies partway through.
